mcqs.question: On the occasion of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose’s 125th birth anniversary on 23 January 2022, the statue installed near India Gate was sculpted by whom?
mcqs.explanation: The statue of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose installed near India Gate on 23 January 2022 was sculpted by Arun Yogiraj. Lt. Col. Seetha Ashok Shelke was associated with the Individual category of the Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar, while Raja Mahendra Pratap Singh and Rash Behari Bose were associated with the original formation of the Azad Hind Fauj.
